The pipeline's atom: company + role, stage pill, next action, deadline. Bottom hairline only — no card chrome per row.

```jsx
<ApplicationRow company="Monzo" role="Backend Engineering Intern" stage="interview"
  nextAction="Confirm Thursday 14:00 slot" deadline="14 Sep" daysLeft={2} />
```

Company avatars are initial-in-a-square placeholders — no logo scraping.
